GPTR-F-001-S145.title: Allowlist Validation Engine Core Logic
GPTR-F-001-S145.description: Implement the core validation engine that enforces allowlist rules on GPTReader requests, including validation of collection names, query operators, field-level restrictions, and result size limits before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S146.title: Azure Function Request Enforcement Layer
GPTR-F-001-S146.description: Wrap the GPTReader Azure Function entrypoint with enforcement logic that intercepts all incoming requests, applies allowlist validation, and blocks or sanitizes invalid queries before reaching the data layer.

GPTR-F-001-S147.title: Allowlist Enforcement Test Suite
GPTR-F-001-S147.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement including valid queries, rejected queries, boundary conditions (size limits, field violations), and regression coverage aligned with existing GPTReader tests.

GPTR-F-001-S148.title: GPTReader Pipeline Integration with Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S148.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the existing GPTReader query pipeline ensuring compatibility with bearer token authentication, audit logging, and response size constraints without breaking current functionality.
